artworks.title: Statue d'homme d'etat
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a town square with a statue, market, and various activities. The scene includes a statue on a pedestal, old buildings, a church spire, people, and market vendors. In the foreground, a seated figure tends to a display of goods. The drawing is detailed with elaborate line work capturing the urban setting. A text by François Coppée is shown on the right, along with the artist's signature, "A. Lepère" on the bottom right.

artworks.title: Centaur (Le centaure)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with natural elements and poetic text. The image portrays human figures intertwined in foliage. The figures are detailed with musculature and flowing hair in a dynamic composition. Patterns of leaves and branches surround them, creating movement. At the bottom, there is a block of poetic text in French. The style suggests an influence from late 19th to early 20th-century illustrators.

artworks.title: Johannes Hoornbeeck
artworks.description: The image displays an upper-body portrait of a man. He is seated and facing slightly to his left, with wavy, shoulder-length dark hair. The man has distinct facial features including arched eyebrows, a moustache, and a goatee. He is wearing a dark, intricately detailed robe with buttons down the front, over a white collared shirt with a large collar. In his right hand, he is holding a closed book. The background consists of a simple, parallel-line texture, highlighting the subject in the foreground.

artworks.title: Hercules Killing Cacus
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 35.3 x 26.9 cm (13 7/8 x 10 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two muscular, nude male figures in a dynamic struggle. The man on the left wears a helmet with a face and holds a club in his right hand, while his left hand grips a detached head. The man on the right has wild hair and is pulling at the other man's helmet with his mouth open. In the background, there is a cave-like setting with rocky formations. A skeletal head is seen in the upper right. Bones and a skull are scattered on the ground. A leafless tree and branches are visible in the landscape.

artworks.title: Hercules Killing Cacus
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 35.9 x 26.9 cm (14 1/8 x 10 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is an image of a mythological scene. It shows two muscular figures in a struggle in a rocky terrain. One figure holds a weapon, while the other shows signs of tension and struggle. There are skeletal remains on the ground and a spectral head in the corner. The drawing style resembles an etching or engraving from the Renaissance period.

artworks.title: An Oriental Ruler Seated on His Throne
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. Robert M. Light
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting on a throne with intricate details. He has a beard, mustache, and styled hair under a crown. He wears regal robes with patterns, beads, and clasps. The man holds a sword and gazes intensely at the viewer. The throne has decorative armrests and a carved back. In the background, there is a shaded wall with the number "1523" on it.

artworks.title: Hampstead Heath, with St. Paul's in the Distance (Vignette)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from a slightly elevated angle, with rugged terrain stretching out. The horizon is low, emphasizing the expansive sky filled with swirling clouds. A figure is visible on the horizon, against the vast scene. The color palette is monochromatic with varying shades of grayscale creating depth and texture. The ground is textured and uneven with markings suggesting foliage and rocky formations. The terrain slopes downwards in the distance, adding depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Mill near Brighton
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene with a large windmill slightly off-center. The horizon is low, with structures and foliage obscuring it. The windmill reaches up into the cloud-filled sky. The brushstrokes or etching lines are expressive, with dark tonalities creating a dramatic atmosphere. The color palette is primarily brown and sepia. A figure is visible on a winding path leading towards the windmill and a small house among trees and shrubs. The background shows swirling clouds in the sky.

artworks.title: A Mill
artworks.description: The image shows a windmill on the left side, with the horizon placed low in the composition. Along the horizon are structures and treetops. The brushstrokes are varied and expressive, capturing movement and light through blends and lines. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of browns and grays. Closest to us are a path and shaded buildings, while in the distance are additional structures and fields under a sky filled with clouds and birds.

artworks.title: Summer Evening
artworks.description: The image shows a view from an elevated vantage point overlooking a pastoral landscape. Rolling hills and scattered trees fill the horizon, diminishing in size towards the distance. A crescent moon is visible in the upper left, set against a sky with swirling clouds. The brushstrokes are loose and dynamic, especially in the depiction of the clouds. The color palette consists of muted tones of black, gray, and hints of white. In the foreground, there are grazing cows and a grouping of detailed trees on the right.

artworks.title: Summer Evening
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a horizon dividing the land from a sky filled with clouds and a crescent moon. In the foreground, there is a grassy field with grazing cattle, followed by various trees leading to hills in the distance. The colors mainly consist of shades of gray and black, emphasizing light and shadow. The painting technique conveys depth and dynamism to the scene.

artworks.title: Spring
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from an elevated perspective. There is a farmer working the land with a plow drawn by two horses on the right side. A windmill stands on the right, and the horizon is visible with vegetation and structures. The sky is filled with clouds, and some birds are flying. The painting has fluid brushstrokes depicting movement and texture. The color palette is muted, ranging from soft greys to deeper blacks. A large tree is depicted on the left side.

artworks.title: Old Sarum (a)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with rolling hills, a dynamic sky with swirling clouds, and a small figure walking along the land.

artworks.title: Stoke-by-Neyland
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a church on the left side. The horizon includes faint traces of buildings. Clouds fill the sky, and birds are visible. The color palette is mainly shades of gray. Close to the viewer, there are two seated figures near a dirt path leading to a shaded area with trees.

artworks.title: Stoke-by-Neyland
artworks.description: The image shows a rural landscape with a dramatic sky, a church with a tall tower at the horizon, swirling clouds, trees with textured strokes, a monochromatic color palette, two figures walking towards the church, and smaller buildings in the distance.

artworks.title: A Summerland
artworks.description: There is an elevated landscape scene showing the countryside. The horizon is positioned about a third from the bottom, with a line of trees and open fields extending into the distance. The sky dominates the scene with cloud formations. The image uses a monochrome palette of grays to balance light and shadow, creating a dramatic sky. A figure is seen working the land with a horse and plow, surrounded by trees.

artworks.title: Hadleigh Castle (Large Plate)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with ruins overlooking the sea. In the background, the horizon separates the sky and sea with ships visible. In the foreground, there are the remains of a structure, potentially a castle or tower, with scattered stones. People and animals can be seen among the ruins. The sky has stormy clouds and the color palette consists mainly of sepia and earth tones.

artworks.title: A Dell, Helmingham Park, Suffolk
artworks.description: The image shows a wooded area with trees on both sides. The horizon is obscured by dense foliage and tree trunks. In the center, there is a rough bridge over a small stream with small figures standing on it. In the lower left corner, a cow stands beside the water. The artwork features textured brushstrokes or etching in a black and white palette, capturing light and shadow in the scene.

artworks.title: Weymouth Bay
artworks.description: The image shows a coastline under a turbulent sky. The horizon is low in the frame, emphasizing the vast sky. Expressive brushstrokes create dynamic clouds and waves. The color palette is grayscale, contrasting the sky with the beach and cliffs. Two figures walk along the rocky shoreline. The coastline curves into the distance, disappearing into darker tones. The image conveys the power of a coastal storm through light and shadow.

artworks.title: Autumnal Sunset
artworks.description: The image displays a pastoral landscape from an elevated perspective. The horizon is positioned about a third from the top, creating depth. In the distance, there are low trees and a faint building or windmill. The brushstrokes are soft and flow naturally. The color scheme is monochromatic, ranging from greys to blacks. A path with figures and horses leads into the scene. Fields and trees create a patchwork effect.

artworks.title: Noon
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a vast sky filled with dramatic clouds. A shepherd with sheep is visible on a grassy slope, with a large tree to the right. The scenery extends to fields and vegetation leading to the distant horizon. Brushstrokes are fluid and textured, especially in the clouds and foliage. The color palette is composed of sepia tones, creating a nostalgic and timeless effect.

artworks.title: Yarmouth, Norfolk
artworks.description: The image features a seaside view from the perspective of the shore. A rowboat and cart are on the sandy beach, with a figure walking along the shore. Sailing ships and small boats dot the horizon, indicating a busy harbor. The sky is dominant, with dramatic clouds and sunlight breaking through. The color palette is sepia tones, giving a timeless quality. The artwork appears to be a finely rendered print with detailed linework.

artworks.title: River Stour
artworks.description: The image shows a riverscape with a village and distant structures in the horizon. There is a large tree on the left side casting a shadow. Boats with sails are near the water's edge, alongside people and lush foliage. The brushstrokes combine smooth and textured techniques, creating depth and contrast, especially in the cloudy sky. The color palette consists mainly of browns and blacks, giving an antique feel to the scene. Overall, the image conveys a serene and picturesque riverside scene.

artworks.title: A Lock on the Stour
artworks.description: The image displays a riverside scene with a mid to upper horizon line. Small houses and trees line the horizon. In the foreground, two figures rest near a wooden structure by the water. Large trees on the left and right add dynamism. The brushstrokes show texture, movement, and contrast. The color palette consists of rich browns and earthy tones. The scene creates a harmonious blend of natural elements in a pastoral landscape.
